GITHUB

Turn Browser Tabs Into Creative Moodboards

I recently went looking for a Chrome extension that would let me jot down quick sticky notes in my new tab. I found a few extensions that got the job done, but they were not nearly as satisfying as I would have hoped. Then I had the idea for what ended up becoming Canvas Tab - what if the whole new tab space was just an editable canvas for me to do whatever I wanted on it?

I wanted some little configurable widgets I could add, I wanted to be able to paste links into the editor, and I wanted to be able to add images and create compositions of some kind.

NEW TAB WHITEBOARD EXAMPLE

WHAT TO DO WITH AN EMPTY NEW BROWSER TAB

What's the best way to use a brand new, blank browser tab...?

Any ideas?

I had a few!

I thought: wouldn't it be cool to turn the new tab into a sort of blank creative canvas that you could add widgets to, doodle on, maybe even listen to a music playlist in?

You can call it whichever you prefer: a canvas, a whiteboard, a moodboard...or just an editor.

What matters is that it is your space to do whatever you see fit with.

Here are just a few things you can do using Canvas Tab:

  • Jot down quick notes

  • Insert images and stickers

  • Draw, doodle and daydream

  • Design a collage

CURRENTLY SUPPORTED WIDGETS

I figured I'd add a small library of pre-configured widgets that users could then customize and make their own.

Here are the pre-made widgets that Canvas Tab currently supports:

  • Activity Tracker: tap or click on an activity square to increase your count for the day. Edit the labels and icons if you want to. Total is calculated at the bottom. At the end of the day, you can export your activities.

  • Audio Playlist: click to add a music playlist and add your favorite songs as .mp3 or .wav files.

  • Bookmarks: enable permissions for the widget to auto-fetch page titles and then all you have to do is paste the URL and click add to save your favorite links in one spot.

  • Checklists: great for tracking and managing to-do lists, goals and other tasks.

  • Image Galleries: use Ctr + click to select all the photos and images you want, then create a slideshow viewer.
